We can walk, use a bicycle, motorcycle or a car within the town to deliver incoming cargo to customers. In this business start-up simulation game, you have to make serious decisions and work hard to expand your cargo company.[/url]
[b]JOIN DISCORD [/b]
https://discord.gg/BQ9xPdpEKu

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757600/My_Corp_Cargo_Simulator/]ABOUT GAME 
You quit your job and moved to a town to be your own boss. Although the town is small, it is constantly growing. He is building new streets. The biggest problem of this happy and peaceful town is that there is no cargo company in the town. Taking this opportunity, you develop and establish your own cargo company in this town, which will turn into a city. Your goal is to be the only cargo company in this town.

Establish your own cargo company in this journey that starts in a small warehouse and extends to a large warehouse!
You have many customers waiting in line. Don't keep your customers waiting in line and pay their invoices quickly!
Find addresses and deliver cargo. Remember, you need to deliver the cargo on time. You and your employees must deliver all cargo to customers as soon as possible. Otherwise, the products can be returned.
How will you deliver the cargo? Will you walk around town or transport cargo by car?
Use the scale to deceive customers or be an honest delivery boy.[/url]
